request.description:
Returns the project with its parent agency nested under `agency` (`uuid`, `name`, `contactEmail`, `website`). Used by the client portal to read agency identity for the sidebar.

Errors:
- `403` with `{ "code": 27003 }` (`AgencySubscriptionInactiveException`) when the requester is a `ROLE_CLIENT` user whose parent agency has no active subscription. Agency members are never gated.

request.description:
Uploads or replaces the current agency's logo. Accepts `image/png` up to 5 MB. The logo is always stored at `private/uploads/agency/logo/{agencyUuid}.png`, so a subsequent upload overwrites the previous one. Auth: `ROLE_ADMIN` + `AgencyVoter::MANAGE_SETTINGS`. Returns `204 No Content`.

Errors:
- `400` with `{ "code": 27004, "meta": { "reason": "..." } }` (`AgencyLogoInvalidException`) when the file is missing, oversized, or not a PNG.

Returns the agency logo as a binary image (inline disposition). `200 OK` with the PNG when a logo exists, `204 No Content` when none has been uploaded yet — the frontend handles the empty state. Access: any authenticated user that belongs to the agency, either as collaborator (`User.agency`) or via their client project (`User.project.agency`).
